svg.title: JacHammer, Jaseci Labs, 2026
svg.desc: An AI app builder. Describe an app in chat, an agent builds it in Jac, and it runs in a live preview you can deploy. Opens the case study at https://www.thiruvarankanm.work/work/jachammer.
